item.title: More Ores and Tools Add-On
item.creator: Netherpixel
item.description:
You've found the Add-On of your dreams! We've added new ores, tools, and armors. With this Add-On, your survival experience will be truly enriched, creating a paradise for all miners.
+40 new ores

+24 new armors and tools

Discover the full potential of this remarkable Add-On!

faqEntries.heading: How do I activate the More Ores and Tools add-on?
faqEntries.content:
Just like any other Marketplace add-on — enable it under Global Resources or in your 
world's Behavior Packs and Resource Packs settings. No special steps needed.

faqEntries.heading: How do I obtain Tin ingots?
faqEntries.content:
Find Cassiterite ore, mine it with any pickaxe, then smelt the raw Cassiterite in the 
Foundry to get a Tin ingot.

faqEntries.heading: What is the Crucible used for?
faqEntries.content:
The Crucible lets you fuse two metals together to create alloys. For example, combining 
Tin and Copper produces Bronze.

faqEntries.heading: How does the Foundry work?
faqEntries.content:
The Foundry melts ores into ingots, but each ore has its own melting temperature. You'll 
need special fuels to raise the Foundry's heat high enough to smelt tougher metals.

faqEntries.heading: How do I craft the new tools, weapons, and armor?
faqEntries.content:
You must first craft the MOT Crafting Table using your vanilla Crafting Table. All new gear 
from this add-on is crafted at the MOT Crafting Table.

faqEntries.heading: What does the Codex do?
faqEntries.content:
Craft a Magnifying Glass and scan any ore with it to unlock its entry in the Codex. Each 
entry shows which layers the ore spawns at and its required mining category. The Codex 
also acts as a reference for each ore's stats and tracks your overall discovery progression.

item.howToTitle: How to Use More Ores and Tools

howToEntries.heading: Explore & Mine
howToEntries.content:
Once active, new ores generate underground across your world, alongside new 
structures to explore. Mine these ores to start gathering resources for your new equipment.

howToEntries.heading: Discover Ores with the Codex
howToEntries.content:
Craft a Magnifying Glass and use it to scan any ore you find. This unlocks its entry in 
your Codex, revealing which layers it spawns at and its mining category — a handy 
reference as you explore.

howToEntries.heading: Craft the MOT Crafting Table
howToEntries.content:
Before crafting any new tools, weapons, or armor, you must first craft the MOT 
Crafting Table using your vanilla Crafting Table. All new items are then made using this 
special table.

howToEntries.heading: Smelt Ores in the Foundry
howToEntries.content:
Use the Foundry to melt raw ores into ingots. Each ore has its own melting 
temperature, so you'll need to feed the Foundry special fuels to raise its heat high enough to 
smelt tougher metals.

howToEntries.heading: Combine Metals in the Crucible
howToEntries.content:
The Crucible lets you fuse two different metals together to create alloys. For 
example, combining Tin and Copper produces Bronze, unlocking a new tier of tools and 
armor.

howToEntries.heading: Trade, Explore & Battle
howToEntries.content: Visit the Merchant to trade your ores for rare items, explore newly generated structures for loot, and track down the boss for a powerful reward once defeated.
